name: Sandra Lynn Perkins
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Sandra Lynn Perkins practices in the areas of estate planning and probate law, including assisting clients with charitable transfers and challenging family issues. After 20 years in practice, she opened her own law office in January 2000. Sandra is a Fellow of the American College of Trust and Estate Counsel (ACTEC), and she has served on the Executive Committee of WSBA's Real Property, Probate, and Trust Section. Sandra is a third generation lawyer who grew up helping out in her father's law office in Boothbay Harbor, Maine. She and her husband, UW architecture professor Jeffrey Ochsner (author of Lionel H. Pries, Architect, Artist, Educator, and co-author of Shaping Seattle Architecture ), live in northeast Seattle with their Maine Coon cat, Theodore.

Sandra is deeply distressed about the ongoing attacks on the Rule of Law, which is the foundation of our democracy. Everyone’s rights are at risk. We must unite to defeat autocracy in the USA! NO KINGS!
